description: Compares two books' vocabularies: the word counts of each, how many words they share, the rare words they share (most of whose uses are in these two books), and the words only one uses, 15 of each by default (limit 1-40). Same language only: two Hebrew books, two Greek ones, or a Septuagint book (editionA: septuagint) against a New Testament book. Use when the user asks how the vocabularies of two books compare.

editionA.description: edition of the first book, e.g. septuagint

editionB.description: edition of the second book, e.g. hebrew-nt

limit.description: how many results to return (1-40, default 15)

max_chars.description: optional: cap the answer at about this many characters (lists are shortened and marked truncated; use offset/nextOffset to get the rest)

name: compare_books
title: Compare two books' vocabulary
